task.request: Determine whether an unauthenticated external client can impersonate an arbitrary existing user in the actual deployment by sending a trusted-email header to POST /signin.

policySources.text: Trusted-header authentication is safe only when a trusted reverse proxy is the sole reachable ingress, removes any client-supplied identity header, and injects the authenticated identity itself.
